## What's Changed
* feat: auth improvements by @yehorsobko-mac in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/pull/217
* chore: improvements and fixes by @yehorsobko-mac in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/pull/223


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/compare/0.12.0...0.12.1

## What's Changed
* feat: 2025-11-25 review fixes by @yehorsobko-mac in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/pull/201
* Auth implementation ([SEP-990](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/issues/990), [SEP-1046](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/issues/1046)) by @yehorsobko-mac in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/pull/205
* fix https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/issues/203 NetworkTransport race, with main-isolated variables https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/pull/206 by @paaloeye and @wti

## New Contributors
@paaloeye made their first contribution in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/pull/203
@wti made their first contribution in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/pull/203

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/compare/0.11.0...0.12.0

## What's Changed
* The latest [2025-11-25](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25) specification covered*
* Conformance tests added ([SEP-1730](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/pull/1777)) in #197
* Icons and metadata support added ([SEP-973](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/issues/973)) in #181 
* Elicitation updates added ([SEP-1034](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/issues/1034), [SEP-1036](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/issues/1036),  [SEP-1330](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/issues/1330)) in #198 
* Added Server Http Transport in #197
* Fixed Network Transport in #198 

_*Not covered yet:_
- Experimental Task support ([SEP-1686](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/issues/1686))
- Sampling with tools ([SEP-1577](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/issues/1577))
- Auth updates ([SEP-990](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/issues/990), [SEP-1046](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol/issues/1046))

## What's Changed
* Move `Sampling.swift` from `Server` to `Client` directory by @mattt in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/pull/121
* Add `Client.listResourceTemplates` method by @carlpeaslee in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/pull/125
* Adjust logging level for frequent / low-level events by @mattt in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/pull/130
* Update `inputSchema` example usage by @mattt in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/pull/136
* Add configuration for maximum receive buffer size to `NetworkTransport` by @mattt in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/pull/146
* Remove Loopwork copyright from license by @carlpeaslee in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/pull/148
* Make `Tool.inputSchema` non-optional by @mattt in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/pull/123
* remove info level logging message and use debug instead by @sebsto in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/pull/132
* Implement in-memory / passthrough transport by @mattt in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/pull/122
* Add plumbing to set instructions on Server by @glaciotech in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/pull/145
* Replace compile-time directives with target platform conditions by @pepicrft in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/pull/143
* Revert "Revert "Remove deprecated `MCP.Error` typealias"" by @mattt in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/pull/105
* docs: fix code example in README.md by @phimage in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/pull/141
* Add `requestModifier` property to `HTTPClientTransport` by @mattt in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/pull/152

* Improve NetworkTransport and add test coverage by @mattt in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/pull/108

* Add support for sampling by @mattt in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/swift-sdk/pull/119
